support.text: Add number of Darkness Cards in DP Slot x200 to own Attack Power.
If own Specialty is Fire, boost own ○ Attack Power +250.
If own HP are more than 100, lose 100 HP and boost own Attack Power +250.
If own Attack is △, boost own △ Attack Power +100 and attack first.
If own Specialty is Fire, lower opponent's Attack Power -150 and boost own ○ Attack Power +100.
If own Specialty is Fire, boost own Attack Power +150 and draw 1 Card.
If own Attack is △, boost own △ Attack Power +200 and attack first.
If own Specialty is Fire and 3 or more Cards remain in own Online Deck, discard 3 Cards from own Online Deck and boost own Attack Power +350.

attacks.name: Crimson Wave of the Beast King

support.text: If own Specialty is Fire, recover own HP +250 and boost own Attack Power +150.
If own HP are less than opponent's HP, recover own HP +200 and boost own Attack Power +400.
If own Specialty is Ice and own Attack is △, attack first and lower opponent's ○ Attack Power -100.
If own Specialty is Ice, recover own HP +150 and lower opponent's △ Attack Power -80.
If own HP are 500 or less, halve opponent's Attack Power.
If own Specialty is Ice and own Attack is ○, boost own ○ Attack Power +150 and attack first.
If own Specialty is Ice, lower opponent's ○ Attack Power to 0 and recover own HP +100.
If own Specialty is Ice, draw 2 Cards and lower opponent's Attack Power -100.
If own Specialty is Ice, boost own △ Attack Power +200 and attack first.
If own Specialty is Ice and own Attack is △, double own △ Attack Power.
If own Specialty is Ice, change opponent's Attack from ○ to △, △ to ✕, or ✕ to ○, then lower opponent's Attack Power -200.
Change own Specialty to opponent's Specialty and draw 1 Card.
If own Specialty is Nature, add number of Nature Cards in own DP Slot x40 to own Attack Power and draw 1 Card.
If own Specialty is Nature, recover own HP +150 and draw 1 Card.
If own Specialty is Nature, lower opponent's Attack Power -150 and recover own HP +100.
If own Specialty is Nature, boost own ○ Attack Power +250 and lower opponent's ✕ Attack Power to 0.
If own Specialty is Nature, recover own HP +200 and add number of Nature Cards in own DP Slot x50 to own ○ Attack Power.
If own Specialty is Nature, void opponent's Digimon Support Effect, halve own Attack Power and recover own HP +200.
If own Specialty is Nature and at least 1 Card is in own DP Slot, discard 1 Card from own DP Slot, boost own Attack Power +200 and attack first.
If own Specialty is Nature, lower own Attack Power -100. Digimon KO'd in this battle revives with 300 HP; the battle still counts as a loss.
If own Specialty is Darkness, discard 2 Cards from opponent's Online Deck and draw 1 Card.
If own Specialty is Darkness and own HP are 400 or less, boost own Attack Power +250.
If own Specialty is Darkness, opponent uses △ and opponent's △ Attack Power is lowered by 100.
If own Specialty is Darkness and at least 1 Card is in own DP Slot, discard 1 Card from own DP Slot, recover own HP +300 and discard 3 Cards from opponent's Online Deck.
If opponent's Specialty is Darkness and own HP are more than 100, lose 100 HP and boost own Attack Power +300.
If own Specialty is Darkness, own attack gains Eat-up HP and opponent's ○ Attack Power is lowered by 100.
If own Specialty is Darkness, halve opponent's ○ Attack Power and boost own ○ Attack Power +150.
If opponent's Specialty is Darkness, void opponent's Digimon Support Effect and lower own Attack Power -100.
If opponent's HP are more than own HP, own attack gains Eat-up HP and own △ Attack Power is boosted by 150.
If own Specialty is Rare and own HP are 300 or less, boost own Attack Power +200 and opponent's Attack Power +100.
If own Specialty is Rare, recover own HP +150 and boost own ○ Attack Power +100.
If own Specialty is Rare, recover own HP +100 and lower opponent's ○ Attack Power -100.
If own Specialty is Rare, boost own ○ Attack Power +250 and lower opponent's ○ Attack Power -100.
If opponent uses ○, counterattack and attack second, and recover own HP +200.
If own Specialty is Rare, boost own △ Attack Power +150 and lower opponent's △ Attack Power -150.
If own Specialty is Rare and own HP are more than 100, lose 100 HP, boost own ○ Attack Power +150 and attack first.
If own Specialty is Rare and at least 1 Card is in own DP Slot, discard 1 Card from own DP Slot, boost own Attack Power +300 and draw 1 Card.
If own Specialty is Rare and own HP are less than opponent's HP, recover own HP +400 and lower opponent's Attack Power -200.
